skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the international and domestic legal framework for international commercial arbitration, including international arbitration rules, organizations, and practices.
Apply knowledge through reading real cases, textbooks, and other research materials related to international arbitration.
Develop critical thinking skills necessary for advocacy and dispute resolution.
Write arbitration decisions with clear structure, logical reasoning, and proper citation.
Communicate effectively in written form, adhering to legal standards and international arbitration rules.
Understand and apply professional ethics and social responsibility in arbitration.
Work independently and take responsibility for personal tasks.
Understand and apply alternative dispute resolution (ADR) methods and international commercial arbitration.
Analyze legal issues and arbitration cases effectively.
Negotiate and draft arbitration clauses for specific transactions.
